description: Returns all pending staff invitations for your DeskMonitor workspace — people who have been invited but have not yet accepted. Use when the user asks 'who has a pending invite?', 'show me outstanding invitations', 'list invitations', or 'did my invite send?'. OwnerAdmin and Admin roles only. Returns an array of invitation objects with email, name, status, and sent date.
name: list_pending_invitations

invitations.description: Array of pending invitation objects (email, name, status, createdAt, etc.)

title: List Pending Invitations
